frame: Every element tagged shop in OpenStreetMap inside the boundaries of ten named UK cities that also carries a website tag, deduplicated to one entry per domain
method: One homepage request per domain. An address counts as published only when it appears in a mailto: href. Consumer providers, RFC 2606 reserved names and websites pointing at a social or marketplace platform are excluded. A domain counts as dead only where DNS alone establishes it — no MX plus an address record on a static host that does not run SMTP, or no MX and no address record. Verdicts resting on a port-25 probe are reported separately because outbound 25 is widely blocked.
